Three grays with lightness 0.16, 0.50 and 0.86. The dark gray is fully in the shadow mask, which is 0.7 there, so red would drop by 0.7 x 0.3 x 255 = 53.6, which clips it to 0, and blue rises by 53.6. The middle gray is in the midtone mask only, which has no shifts here, so it does not change. The light gray gets the highlight shifts. With Preserve luminosity, the light gray keeps its HSL lightness, so its channels spread around the old level.
